visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young woman with dark hair and bangs. She is wearing a glossy, pinkish-brown lipstick and points at her chin with a pink-nailed finger. The background is a soft-focus indoor setting with shelves. (2) She holds up four Maybelline lipstick tubes in front of her face, showcasing the packaging which matches the shades inside. She smiles warmly at the camera. (3) The woman holds a glass of pearl milk tea with a straw that has a decorative lipstick graphic attached. She holds multiple lipstick boxes in her other hand. (4) A close-up of a forearm is shown, displaying seven distinct swatches of lipstick ranging from pale nude to deep berry, each labeled with numbers and names. (5) In a sequence of close-up shots, she applies the lipstick using a wand and her finger, demonstrating the texture and shine. She poses and smiles, showing the finished look. (6) A split-screen comparison shows 'Before' and 'After' shots of her face, highlighting the difference the lipstick makes to her overall appearance. (7) She takes a drink of pearl milk tea through a straw to demonstrate that the lipstick does not transfer onto the straw. She points to the clean straw with a triumphant expression. (8) The woman continues to show different shades on her lips while holding the corresponding tubes. She uses hand gestures like peace signs and points to her cheeks. (9) The video concludes with her holding several lipstick boxes and waving at the camera, with promotional text overlays about discounts and a brand collaboration.
